scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name vakastudio --branch main
scripts.waitlist: wrangler d1 execute vakastudio-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT app, email, source, created_at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at"
